title: DataQualityEnvelopeV1
description: Frozen contract (PLAN v3.0 §2.2). Every Dashboard/snapshot response from the control-plane MUST carry these fields. No fixture/fake fallback: when there is no real data, return real empty state with stale/unavailable markers. Above the freshness threshold, stale MUST be true and Hermes auto-approval of new risk is forbidden.

data_source.description: Origin of the read model, e.g. 'postgres_projection'. Never 'fixture' or 'fake' in production.
